subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill descriptions be expanded with concise WHEN/trigger wording now, or should trigger-like routing move to a structured skill metadata contract instead?
rationale: Current source still uses descriptions as the prompt selection signal, but current docs and skill-creator guidance prioritize compact descriptions, so automation should not choose the public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one focused metadata-only update that adds short WHEN wording only where it improves bundled skill routing without bloating descriptions.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 as the canonical owner for exact keyword semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that the current concise description style is intentional and close related cleanup attempts as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one focused metadata-only update that adds short WHEN wording only where it improves bundled skill routing without bloating descriptions.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has relevant skill metadata/docs history and is a better fit for the product-policy choice than a purely mechanical current-line owner.
